prompt:
Use exactly 1 uploaded image. @Image1 is the highest-priority reference for the adult Japanese woman. Preserve her face, identity, skin tone, body proportions and appearance. If outfit is unclear: fitted black office blazer, white satin blouse, charcoal pleated midi skirt, sheer black stockings, black low heels, dark commuter bag. Long straight jet-black hair below shoulders with soft wispy bangs. Realistic adult 20+, elegant professional appearance. No anime, CGI or plastic skin.

Create exactly 30 seconds, 16:9 landscape, native 4K, 24fps, ultra-realistic live-action third-person stealth gameplay. One continuous over-the-shoulder shot from 00:00–25.5, then ONE hard cut to a fixed workstation shot. No other cuts, BGM, subtitles, narration, watermark or captions. Natural Japanese dialogue; English HUD only.

SETTING:
One connected modern Japanese corporate office: bright lobby → security desk → access gate → glass corridor → open-plan office → mobile whiteboard → workstation. Morning sunlight from right-side windows. Exactly ONE physical white PTZ CCTV above/right of the workstation.

CHARACTERS:
Security guard — Japanese male 40s, broad build, navy uniform, lobby only.
HR associate — Japanese woman 30s, beige suit, black trousers, document cart, corridor only.
Department head — Japanese male around 50, glasses, charcoal suit, white shirt, dark red tie. He is the only pursuer. All have distinct faces and remain consistent.

HUD:
Mini-map + yellow vision cone bottom-left, STAMINA/COMPOSURE top-left, DETECTION top-center, SPRINT/CROUCH/INTERACT/SLIDE bottom-right.
Opening:
【LATE — 12 MIN】
【OBJECTIVE: REACH YOUR DESK UNDETECTED】

00:00–00:07 — LOBBY:
She sprints through the lobby. Guard notices her. She brakes, crouches and slides behind a planter as his vision cone reaches 91%. His radio distracts him. She taps her access card, gate opens, her bag briefly catches, and she escapes into the corridor. Detection drops to 34%. Guard never follows.

00:07–00:13 — CORRIDOR:
HR associate pushes a tall document cart. She hides behind it and moves around it while the HR looks left and right. Detection reaches 96% but she is not clearly seen. She slips into the open office. HR never chases.

00:13–00:18 — ALERT:
Department head sees her reflection in the glass and recognizes her. Camera briefly shows his face. A large red 【!】 flashes exactly twice and DETECTION becomes red 【ALERT】.
He shouts:
「ちょっと待って！」
She replies:
「やばい！」
Then she runs.

00:18–00:23.5 — CHASE:
She pulls a wheeled whiteboard sideways to block him, then physically slides through the narrow gap between the board and a desk. He moves around it and continues chasing. Maintain realistic foot contact, friction, momentum, bag inertia, hair and clothing movement.

00:23.5–00:25.5 — DESK:
She reaches her workstation, grabs the desk, spins into the chair, opens the laptop and rapidly types as if working. Detection falls 98% → 7%.
HUD:
【MISSION COMPLETE】
【STEALTH RANK: S】
She gives a tiny satisfied smile.

25.5s — HARD CUT.

00:25.5–00:30 — CCTV TWIST:
Fixed frontal workstation shot showing her face, upper body, laptop and the physical PTZ CCTV. CCTV initially faces the hallway. At 00:26.3 it mechanically rotates about 45° toward her and its red indicator activates.

HUD:
【CCTV DETECTED】

Her smile freezes and she slowly looks toward the camera.

Department head speaks through the speaker:
「ピョナさん、私の部屋に来てください。」

At 00:28.8:
【MISSION FAILED】
【LATE PENALTY +1】
【NEXT: SURVIVE THE MEETING】

She widens her eyes slightly and drops her shoulders. Final frame clearly shows her frozen expression and CCTV facing her with its red light.

PHYSICS:
Fast but realistic movement, weight, friction, balance, recovery, wheel rotation, bag inertia, hair/clothing motion and environmental interaction.
